title: Compile budget: serve A2A in-tree without the ra2a SDK
goal: CEO: bring Susi core under 30 s. ra2a 0.10.1 (through susi-vendor-ra2a) is the only path from the susi build to reqwest, hyper-tls, encoding_rs, chrono, tower-http, uuid, futures and thiserror. Serve the subset of A2A the daemon serves (agent card, JSON-RPC message send, SSE streaming, tasks get/list/cancel/resubscribe, push-notification configs and delivery, the 1.0 method names and the slash aliases, the error codes) from crates/susi-gawd-a2a/src/protocol on the axum/tokio/hyper stack already in core, with push delivery over susi-http-transport and the bounded task retention unchanged. A transcript of 79 real HTTP exchanges recorded from the ra2a stack before it left is the wire golden the in-tree protocol must reproduce. susi-vendor-ra2a is deleted; ceilings and the wave log record the before/after numbers.
host: Claude Code cloud session, Linux x86_64, 4 vCPU, Rust 1.99.0 (pinned); other agents' builds running (load 3-7)
acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test lean_core_ceilings --test socket_parity --test architecture_tests --test duplication_tests --test orphan_sources --test task_records
cargo tree --offline --locked -p susi -e normal,build -i reqwest (no match)
cargo run --offline --locked -p xtask --bin xtask -- build-time (alternated with base)

results.build_time: cold cargo build -p susi, 4 threads, under load: base 46758d8d8 82.8/74.0/84.3 s, 298.8/268.0/309.2 CPU-s, 371 units; change 75.7/64.4 s, 275.6/226.7 CPU-s, 342 units; removed units cost 27.0 CPU-s in a base run (ra2a 12.6, reqwest 4.8, encoding_rs 2.2, chrono 1.4); no wall gain claimed from the overlapping totals

limitations: Deliberate wire difference: an SSE stream ends after its final (terminal or interrupted) event; ra2a held the connection and a concurrency slot open. Events and bytes before that are identical.

Behaviours kept as ra2a had them, not improved: handler refusals on / are -32603 with a null id (task not found, not cancelable, invalid params); streamed tasks are not recorded in the task store, so tasks/get after message/stream reports not found; extended card is never configured.
Push delivery uses ureq through susi-http-transport instead of reqwest (same method, headers, body, 30 s budget); its User-Agent differs and proxy handling follows the transport.
tasks/list orders tasks by id (ra2a's order was a HashMap's); push configs list in config-id order.
Wall-clock gain not established: the container ran other agents' builds; only the unit count and the removed units' CPU are claimed.

vendor/reqwest and its [patch] entry remain (now unused, listed under patch.unused like fluent-uri); tests/architecture_tests.rs still requires the vendored sources. Removing them is separate cleanup.
No live daemon was started: the stack is exercised by serving the same app() composition serve() runs on a loopback port; DualListener/TLS code is unchanged.
